title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
summary: The briefing's rollout, default state and temporary language behaviour are supported by Microsoft's notice and release notes. Targeted searches found no documented Android administrator switch or automation for it. Minor corrections should preserve the legacy licence qualification and remove the checklist's unmatched default-language control.
